options.name: Senior Shuttle West

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line (fictional)
options.how_to_access: For Medicaid plan members only; call the number on the member card at least 2 business days ahead. Patient has Medicare Advantage, not Medicaid, so likely not eligible unless she also holds Medicaid.

options.how_to_access: Partner program; clinics must verify enrollment before referring. Eligibility check via the program's API using patient name, DOB, and ZIP. Verify before referring.
